summary: Hyperscaler scale review for PR #11: reviewed merged diff metadata and current tree evidence; 2 actionable finding(s), highest severity MAJOR.

findings.issue: Conflict path extraction is a heuristic over merge-tree stdout. It fails closed on unknown markers, which is good, but evidence quality can be empty paths and no machine-readable git status.
findings.remediation: Capture merge-tree exit/status plus raw conflict summary in evidence and add fixtures for rename/delete/binary conflict output shapes.

findings.issue: The app reads/writes JSON registries directly per tick without file locking or compare-and-swap. Multiple webhook/fix-loop invocations can race and lose queue/tick updates.
findings.remediation: Serialize merge-queue writes through a single runner or add lockfile/atomic compare-and-swap semantics with contention tests.
